title: Container w/ Most Water
description: Two pointers at the ends. Water is bounded by the shorter side, so always move the shorter pointer inward. O(n).

notes: Water level is bounded by the SHORTER wall — moving the taller side cannot help; it only shrinks width.
Use `<` (not `<=`) — when l === r the width is 0.

questions.q: Why move the SHORTER side inward instead of the taller?
options: Water is bounded by the shorter wall; moving the taller side only shrinks width

questions.q: Area at each step is computed as:

options: When l === r width is 0 — no container to measure

exercises.prompt: Fill in the two-pointer max-area solution.

blanks.hint: left was shorter — move it inward
right was shorter or equal — move it inward

L3.prompt: Write `maxArea(height)` returning the largest rectangular water area between two vertical lines. Log `maxArea([1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7])`.
hints: Two pointers at the ends, walk inward.
